title: abutilon crassifolium var. tomentosum
intro: Abutilon crassifolium var. tomentosum, commonly known as Woolly Abutilon, is a type of flowering plant in the Malvaceae family. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, inflammation, and digestive problems, thanks to its reported health benefits such as reducing inflammation, acting as an antimicrobial agent, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Abutilon crassifolium var. tomentosum include anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antipyretic effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
